title: Mrs. Maria Petrovna Sheremetoff

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. □□□□□
S.I. Special Branch/Station □
REPORT
Date April 21, 19 38

Subject Mrs. M.P. Sheremetoff, (nee M.P. Fedorischeff)

Made by D.P.S. Rogovenko Forwarded by C Crawford

Maria Petrovna Sheremetoff, Russian, was born on
20.1.04 at Blagovieschensk, Siberia. After finishing a
middle school, she left for Harbin where she resided for two
years, then proceeded to Japan and remained there for about
one and half years. She arrived in Shanghai on the 21.10.27.
She married Vladimir Sheremetoff on 17.2.28 and has a son,
Igor, now 9 years of age.
Locally she worked as a dancing hostess at the Casanova
Ballroom for about three years, in order to augment the family's
income.
Prior to her marriage, she was assisted financially
by her brother, A.P. Fedorischeff, who is a musician.
Her husband was born on 17.7.1896 at Harbarovsk,
Siberia. Formerly he was an officer in the Russian Imperial
Army. He arrived in Shanghai on 1.9.26, and prior to that
date he served for a number of years in Chang Tso Lin's Army.
At present he is without fixed employment and assists his
wife in the management of their boarding house, located at
104 Joffre Terrace.
She intends to proceed to the Netherlands Indies, where
her brother resides, in order to improve her health and enable
her son to receive a better education.
She is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee.
Nothing detrimental is known by this office against her.

D.P.S. Rogovenko
D.P.S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期 1938年4月21日

事由 M.P. 舍列梅托夫夫人（婚前姓 M.P. 费多里谢夫）

呈报人 D.P.S. 罗戈文科 转呈人 C. 克劳福德

玛丽亚·彼得罗芙娜·舍列梅托夫，俄国人，1904年1月20日出生于西伯利亚布拉戈维申斯克。中学毕业后，她前往哈尔滨，在那里居住了两年，随后前往日本，在那里停留了约一年半。她于1927年10月21日抵达上海。她于1928年2月17日与弗拉基米尔·舍列梅托夫结婚，育有一子伊戈尔，现年9岁。
在上海期间，为了增加家庭收入，她在卡萨诺瓦舞厅担任舞女约三年。
婚前，她在经济上由其兄 A.P. 费多里谢夫资助，其兄是一名音乐家。
其丈夫于1896年7月17日出生于西伯利亚哈巴罗夫斯克。他曾是俄罗斯帝国军队的一名军官。他于1926年9月1日抵达上海，在此日期之前，他在张作霖的军队中服役多年。目前他没有固定职业，协助妻子管理位于茹富路104号的寄宿公寓。
她打算前往荷属东印度群岛，她的兄弟居住在那里，目的是改善健康状况并使其子接受更好的教育。
她已在俄国侨民委员会登记。本处未掌握任何对她不利的信息。

D.P.S. 罗戈文科
副巡官

助理总监（特别处）

GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1127.
SHANGHAI, 14th April 1938.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that this Consulate-General has received a request from Mr.A.P.Fedorischeff, residing at Soerabaia, Sumatrastraat 96 to issue a visé for admission into the Netherlands Indies to his sister Maria Petrovna SHEREMETOFF, residing at Shanghai at Joffre Terrace 104.

The passage to the Netherlands Indies will be paid for by Mr.Fedorischeff.

Although the person in question has not yet applied to this Consulate General for a visé, I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know whether anything is known against her from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

[签名]
Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆。
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

第1127号。
上海，1938年4月14日。

先生：

谨此通知贵方，本总领事馆收到居住在苏门答腊岛泗水苏马特拉街96号的 A.P. 费多里谢夫先生的请求，为其居住在上海茹富路104号的妹妹玛丽亚·彼得罗芙娜·舍列梅托夫签发进入荷属东印度群岛的签证。

前往荷属东印度群岛的旅费将由费多里谢夫先生支付。

尽管当事人尚未向本总领事馆申请签证，但若贵方能告知从政治或道德角度是否掌握对其不利的情况，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼

[签名]
总领事
